purpose: User's three-stage flow: (1) train the brainprint extractor using all 20 identities (task-wise standardisation, PCA basis, pre-trained E162 encoder, WCCN whitening); (2) register only the 20-k enrolled identities' prototypes from their fit rows (frac <= 0.6); (3) deploy - identify the enrolled identities and reject the k unregistered identities. Differs from E196, whose strict protocol excluded the held-out identities from the standardisation and PCA as well, i.e. conflated training and registration.

protocol.stage1_training: all 20 identities, fit rows only (frac <= 0.6): per-task mean/sd, PCA basis, WCCN whitening. Fold-invariant, computed once.
protocol.stage2_enrollment: prototypes from the 20-k enrolled identities' fit rows only (frac <= 0.6); k_proto centres per identity
protocol.stage3_deployment: identification (argmax over enrolled prototypes) and rejection (best-match score below the fold threshold) on the 0.6 < frac <= 0.8 block
protocol.threshold_rule: tau = quantile(enrolled identities' known best-match scores in the eval window, 1 - a); only enrolled identities calibrate it

2.note: C(20,2) = 190 < the requested 200, so the full enumeration is used; identical fold plan to E196

5.note: C(20,5) = 15504, 200 distinct folds, seed 20261116+5; identical fold plan to E196

10.note: C(20,10) = 184756, 100 distinct folds, seed 20261116+10; identical fold plan to E196

fusion_normalisation: Each stream's identity-score matrix is standardised with the mean/sd of that fold's enrolled known best-match scores before the weighted sum; single-gate readings are invariant to this step.

reporting.identification_accuracy: share of enrolled eval-window samples whose argmax over the enrolled prototypes is their own identity (unconditional)
reporting.rejection_rate: share of the k unregistered identities' eval-window samples whose best-match score is below the threshold
reporting.auc: enrolled known best-match scores versus unregistered identities' best-match scores
reporting.closed_set_f1: macro-F1 of the argmax assignment over the enrolled identities on the eval window
reporting.test_official: N/A - Test has no identity labels; AUC/F1/C/RA/ASafeR/U/Score are not computable
reporting.session_usage: Test scores are computed before the Session column is read; Session only splits S1 / S2 for the audit and never enters any fit

comparison.note: E196 keeps the strict protocol (standardisation, PCA and prototypes all exclude the held-out identities); the k = 5 difference isolates the effect of training-set size / encoder exposure.
